title.rendered: Network Traffic and Security Monitoring Using ntopng and InfluxDB

content.rendered:
Yesterday our friends at InfluxData organised a meetup at their HQ in San Francisco, CA.

For all those who have been unable to attend the event, these are the presentation slides so you can learn more about the transition from RRD to InfluxDB that is happening in ntopng.

Please do not forget to provide feedback on the ntop mailing list or on github.

Thank you !
